findings.defect: The main theorem does not assume H nonelementary. Its first proof paragraph invokes the standard-GF cofinite injective-component conclusion, whose Statement explicitly assumes H nonelementary, and then infers H nonelementary. No independent derivation is written before that invocation. Ambient Gamma nonelementarity alone is not the missing subgroup premise.
findings.smallest_repair: Preserve every Statement. First use the unconditional finite analytic boundary and injective monodromy to obtain simply connected D. Ambient Lambda_Gamma has at least three points, so D is a proper disk-uniformizable plane domain. Run the actual puncture Schwarz–Pick plus compact-core finite-area argument of standardGF5.1 before its negative-Euler paragraph: it needs no H nonelementarity. Exclude elementary disk groups directly: trivial quotient has infinite area; hyperbolic cyclic quotient has infinite Fermi transverse area; parabolic cyclic strip has divergent integral near y=0; a torsion-free discrete elementary disk group cannot have rank two. Hence H is nonelementary and the previously stated standardGF conclusions now apply. Write the elementary exclusion and logical ordering explicitly; no scope narrowing or extra H premise.
findings.author_response: BMW confirmed the exact missing invocation and this repair route; all sources remain frozen pending this single consolidated finding.

Actual CW5 gauge/path compatibility and relative 3-cell filling checked; actual surface3 uses all boundary maps and connector paths, the relative cover-or-collapse theorem, and degree-one covering. No abstract group isomorphism alone is substituted for a boundary marking.

Finite annulus cuts checked through equivariant dual trees and edge/vertex stabilizers. Finite annulus systems preserve the original group-isomorphic boundary-piece invariant. Cyclic frontier pairs two primitive punctures, has full rank-one cusp stabilizer, excludes a third homotopic puncture by the univalent strip winding argument and constructs separated full canonical tubes.

Main compactness argument checked with ENTIRE boundary-component map, product boundary collar and finite relative orientation chain: the local degree near one bottom point is nonzero and propagates through connected interior, forcing the compact map image onto the full truncated cover. This supplies actual compactness, not just a homotopy equivalence.

Canonical tube cusp volume checked by the transverse bound M+t*sinh(a) and integral of (2M+2t*sinh(a))/t^3; the residual fixed-radius hull neighborhood is compact. No subgroup GF hypothesis is smuggled into that calculation.

Both-rank QI construction checked: explicit compact quotient distance weights/Lorentz combinations, source and target lattice-line/horoball images, rank-one bounded transverse collapse, two reciprocal height maps and globally Lipschitz gluing give bounded composites. Quasicircle proof uses Morse geometry and cross-ratio control rather than asserting arbitrary boundary homeomorphisms are quasisymmetric.

Cofinite-boundary proof checked through a finite disjoint-curve bound, compact core, actual normalized-sphere analytic parameter families with a constant representation fiber, and Fatou/Hardy uniqueness. The final cusp argument uses all peripheral classes and the two-component root closure before promoting finite index to equality.

Comparison chart checked on both full hull-facing surfaces, not only the original one: area gives a short loop at every hull boundary point; mixed-displacement separation and root closure exclude boundary and INTERIOR tube intersections using an injective infinite-volume tube. The explicit near-parabolic normalization, full fixed-disk matrix-overlap injection and Koebe center convergence then give the claimed uniform chart.
